description: Research workspace for SchedulePoint application analysis: navigation structure, screen inventory, and evidence collection.

structure.RESEARCH-RULES.md: Read-only navigation rules for Claude for Chrome: permitted controls, prohibited mutating actions, and the 'if uncertain, do not click' policy governing all ischedule.md exploration
structure.reports/: Written findings, indices, and tracking documents
structure.reports/inbox/: Unsorted/raw notes and evidence awaiting triage into the main reports
structure.screenshots/navigation/: Evidence of top-level nav, menus, and routing between major sections
structure.screenshots/schedule/: Evidence of scheduling/calendar screens and interactions
structure.screenshots/requests/: Evidence of request workflows (submission, approval, status)
structure.screenshots/picklist/: Evidence of picklist/shift-bid or selection-list screens
structure.screenshots/admin/: Evidence of admin-facing configuration and management screens
structure.screenshots/errors/: Evidence of error states, validation messages, and failure modes

namingConvention: Use generic, descriptive filenames only: <area>-<screen-or-state>-<sequence>.png (e.g. schedule-week-view-01.png, requests-submit-error-02.png). No personal names, phone numbers, patient identifiers, employee IDs, or other sensitive data in filenames or file contents.

phaseReports.title: Picklist system: preparation, execution, notifications/escalation, real-time behaviour, completion/correction, with Mermaid diagrams and Given/When/Then criteria
phaseReports.mergePolicy: References PLM-01, PL-01/02, DASH-01, DA-01, ADM-01/05, WF-05a rather than redescribing. Contains a documented, self-corrected safety incident (§0) — an 'Add Room' control created a real room in a live ON HOLD picklist on first click with no preview/confirm step; the accidentally-created room was identified and deleted within the same tool-call sequence, verified back to its prior count.

phaseReports.title: Supporting modules and remaining coverage gaps: reports/statistics, contacts/messaging, documents, profile/notifications/help/integrations
phaseReports.mergePolicy: References CON-01, DOC-01, PL-01/02/03, ADM-01/04, SYS-03/04 rather than redescribing. Executed under strengthened safety boundary (no clicking of Add/New/Create/Import/etc. verbs); evidence gathered via DOM/href inspection rather than speculative clicks. No mutation occurred; one no-op click on a stub Help link recorded as a non-incident.

phaseReports.title: Responsive and accessibility behaviour: layout at desktop/tablet/phone widths, keyboard focus, heading/ARIA/color-only findings, SchedulePoint recommendations (F-01..F-08)
phaseReports.mergePolicy: Adds RA-01..RA-19 and F-01..F-08; references SCH-01/02/03/04/05, VAC-01, CON-01, DOC-01, PLM-01, ADM-05 rather than redescribing their functional behavior. No new action surface opened solely for testing; only Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape used, no Enter/Space on action controls. Bonus finding: passive heading-text inspection resolved Phase 9's open question about what the Master Schedule Print menu produces (5 'Create X Report' dialogs, including a previously-unknown 'DayXShift Report' type).

phaseReports.title: Technical observations: frontend stack, routes, API resource catalogue (API-01..14), request/response patterns, auth/session, real-time (SignalR), caching/performance, client-vs-server responsibility matrix, SchedulePoint implications (T-01..T-10)
phaseReports.mergePolicy: 17-section structure per instructions; all identifiers sanitized (GROUP_ID/USER_ID/PICKLIST_ID/YYYY-MM-DD placeholders); no request replayed/modified/guessed, no cookie/token/storage values recorded (names only). Major findings: confirms a SignalR 'picklist' real-time hub exists (closes part of Phase 8's gap without triggering a live picklist); a concrete N+1-style duplicate-request defect (~25-40x identical calls from one click); a hashed-email leak to Gravatar on every page load; Zendesk support widget silently 503-broken on every page load.

validation.purpose: Confirms all required files and directories exist and required files are non-empty
